flaw.blatant_gift.name: Blatant Gift
flaw.blatant_gift.summary: Your Gift is extremely disturbing to others.

flaw.deficient_technique.name: Deficient {technique}
flaw.deficient_technique.summary: You are unable to use one Technique effectively.

flaw.poor_characteristic.name: Poor {characteristic}
flaw.poor_characteristic.summary: Lower a Characteristic already at −3 down to −5; you still gain the points.

flaw.poor_student.name: Poor Student
flaw.poor_student.summary: You are bad at learning from books and teachers.

virtue.affinity_ability.name: Affinity with {ability}
virtue.affinity_ability.summary: Experience put into one Ability counts for half again, and that Ability is exempt from the age-based cap.

virtue.affinity_art.name: Affinity with {art}
virtue.affinity_art.summary: Experience put into one Art counts for half again. May be taken twice, for two Arts.

virtue.educated.name: Educated
virtue.educated.summary: +50 experience points, spent only on Latin and Artes Liberales. You may buy Academic Abilities.

virtue.faerie_magic.name: Faerie Magic
virtue.faerie_magic.summary: Initiation into the Outer Mystery of House Merinita. Confers the Faerie Magic Ability at 1.

virtue.gentle_gift.name: Gentle Gift
virtue.gentle_gift.summary: Your Gift does not disturb others.

virtue.great_characteristic.name: Great {characteristic}
virtue.great_characteristic.summary: Raise a Characteristic already at +3 up to +5; you still pay the points.

virtue.heartbeast.name: Heartbeast
virtue.heartbeast.summary: Initiation into the Outer Mystery of House Bjornaer. Confers the Heartbeast Ability at 1.

virtue.hermetic_magus.name: Hermetic Magus
virtue.hermetic_magus.summary: You are a member of the Order of Hermes.

virtue.hermetic_prestige.name: Hermetic Prestige
virtue.hermetic_prestige.summary: Other magi look up to you. You gain a Reputation of level 4 within the Order.

virtue.improved_characteristics.name: Improved Characteristics
virtue.improved_characteristics.summary: +3 points to spend on Characteristics. May be taken multiple times.

virtue.minor_magical_focus.name: Minor Magical Focus
virtue.minor_magical_focus.summary: Your magic is attuned to a narrow field; add the lowest applicable Art score twice within it.

virtue.premonitions.name: Premonitions
virtue.premonitions.summary: You sense when something is about to go wrong. Confers the Premonitions Ability at 1.

virtue.privileged_upbringing.name: Privileged Upbringing
virtue.privileged_upbringing.summary: +50 experience points, spent only on General, Academic, or Martial Abilities.

virtue.puissant_ability.name: Puissant {ability}
virtue.puissant_ability.summary: +2 to all rolls with one Ability.

virtue.puissant_art.name: Puissant {art}
virtue.puissant_art.summary: +3 to all totals using one Art. May be taken twice, for two Arts.

virtue.second_sight.name: Second Sight
virtue.second_sight.summary: You see through illusion and concealment and perceive invisible things. Confers the Second Sight Ability at 1.

virtue.self_confident.name: Self-Confident
virtue.self_confident.summary: You have a Confidence Score of 2 and start with five Confidence Points instead of three.

virtue.the_enigma.name: The Enigma
virtue.the_enigma.summary: Initiation into the Outer Mystery of House Criamon. Confers Enigmatic Wisdom at 1.

virtue.the_gift.name: The Gift
virtue.the_gift.summary: You have the ability to work magic.

virtue.verditius_magic.name: Verditius Magic
virtue.verditius_magic.summary: Initiation into the Outer Mystery of House Verditius, enabling the casting of enchantments through craft.

virtue.warrior.name: Warrior
virtue.warrior.summary: +50 experience points, spent only on Martial Abilities, which you may acquire at character creation.
